question: The circumcentre of an equilateral triangle is at a distance of 3.2 cm from the base of the triangle. What is the length (in cm) of each of its altitudes?
solution:
**Given data:**

CIrcumradius = 3.2 cm

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7062ec0839800d7fb7f70c7c7172da1a27e5126b92c49aa5b51411b8100168fc.png] 

From the equilateral triangle property, O is the circumcenter as well as the centroid.

∴ OD = 1over 3 × AD

⇒ AD = 3 × OD

⇒ AD = 3 × 3.2 = 9.6 cm

∴ **The length of the altitudes of the equilateral triangle is 9.6 cm. **
